_comment: C0-14 veo bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（runway/kling），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [gemini-chat, gemini-cli]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 无「实测建议」段（模型接口口径），照源短译。

axes.model_access: Model versions disclosed on Google's official release line: Vertex AI release notes record Veo 3.1 GA (2025-11-17 entry), Veo 3.1 reference-to-video and video extension previews, Veo 3.1 Lite (2026-04-02 entry, officially called the most cost-effective Veo on Vertex AI) — verified via proxied direct fetch 2026-10-21.
axes.runtime: Delivered via the Gemini API / Vertex AI cloud APIs and Google AI subscription plans (product entries such as Flow); generation processed on Google's cloud, no models run locally.
axes.local_files: Supports reference-image input (the reference-to-video capability is in the Vertex release notes entries); retention of input content is in the permissions axis.
axes.background: The API is request-poll based (generation tasks submitted then retrieved); no official statement of a "keep-running-after-shutdown" form.
axes.tools: The main form is a model interface (Gemini API / Vertex AI) integrated by Flow, third-party editing and agent workflows; outputs carry watermarks and SynthID provenance marks.
axes.context: Generation is task-based, no cross-session memory form; context is organized by the caller — reference-to-video and video extension are in-request/across-task linking capabilities (see the Vertex release notes entries), not session memory.
axes.permissions: Official Gemini API Additional Terms (effective 2026-03-23): content submitted and generated answers on non-paid services (AI Studio, free quota) are used to "provide, improve and develop Google products and machine-learning technology", and human reviewers may read them; paid services are not used to improve products and are handled under the data-processing additional terms. EEA/Switzerland/UK users are treated as paid even on the free quota.
axes.fit: Video-generation users and teams already in the Google cloud/Workspace ecosystem needing enterprise-grade data terms (paid means no training). The free-quota line does get trained — don't conflate them; for scenarios that care about provenance marks (SynthID) this is a plus.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. Video generation does not fit the coding test protocol; capability claims follow the official release notes and model docs.
unknowns:
- Tier routing and capability differences of entry products like Flow (not verified product by product by this site)
- The current availability matrix of Veo versions (GA/preview/Lite status rolls with the release notes)
related: Contrast route: creation-platform form, training license with no opt-out option
Contrast route: domestic video generation, commercial use must pass the membership line
